S.PHON: ʔuunakani ʦaau miana
ʔuunakani ʦaau miana
S.TRANSL: Once upon a time, there was a person.

S.FORM: sua caau iisua ia, ta-ssa maamia kin-a-laʔəv-a, sua saruanai-ni=kani ia, ni-mu-ca=kani s<um>a-sərəcə=kani riŋai.
S.PHON: sua ʦaau iisua ia tassa maamia kinaɾaʔəva sua saruanainikani ia nimuʦakani sumasərəʦəkani riŋai
S.FORM: sua caau iisua ia, tassa maamia kinara'eva, sua saruanainikani ia, nimucakani s<um>aserecekani ringai.
S.PHON: sua ʦaau iisua ia tassa maamia kina[r|ɾ]aʔeva sua sa[r|ɾ]uanainikani ia nimuʦakani sumase[r|ɾ]eʦekani [r|ɾ]iŋai
S.TRANSL: The person had a wife, and he was going to check his traps.

S.FORM: sua ʔucaŋ-ini ia, tee=kani mu-a-kusa ʔuma-ʔuma.
S.PHON: sua ʔuʦaŋini ia teekani muakusa ʔumaʔuma
sua ʔuʦaŋini ia teekani muakusa ʔumaʔuma
S.TRANSL: His wife was going to the fields.

S.PHON: ʔuuna maanu uʦani maanu nanakə
ʔuuna maanu uʦani maanu nanake
S.TRANSL: They had one daughter.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: paka-siin=kani saruanai, "tee=ku s<um>a-sərəcə taniara sauni. sua iikasu ia, tee=kasu-ini muu-kusa ʔuma-ʔuma ia, ari-avic-au=ʔai maanu=mita pati-manəŋ-au. ʔakuni=ʔai ʔa-pa-taŋi-ai," kisa-ən kan=kiai ʔucaŋ-ini.
S.PHON: pakaʂiinkani saruanai teeku sumasərəʦə taniara sauni sua iikasu ia teekasuini muukusa ʔumaʔuma ia ariaviʦauʔai maanumita patimanəŋau ʔakuniʔai ʔapataŋiai kisaən kankiai ʔuʦaŋini
S.FORM: pakasiinkani saruanai, "teeku s<um>aserece taniara sauni. sua iikasu ia, teekasuini muukusa 'uma'uma ia, ariavicau'ai maanumita patimanengau. 'akuni'ai 'apatangiai," kisaen kankiai 'ucangini.
S.PHON: pakaʂiinkani sa[r|ɾ]uanai teeku sumase[r|ɾ]eʦe tania[r|ɾ]a sauni sua iikasu ia teekasuini muukusa ʔumaʔuma ia a[r|ɾ]iaviʦauʔai maanumita patimaneŋau ʔakuniʔai ʔapataŋiai kisaen kankiai ʔuʦaŋini
S.TRANSL: The man said, "I'm going to check the traps today, and if you're going to the fields, please take our child with you, and take good care of her. Don't let her cry," he said so to his wife.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: paka-siin=kani saruanai, "tee=ku s<um>a-sərəcə taniara sauni. sua iikasu ia, nuu tee=kasu-ini muu-kusa ʔuma-ʔuma ia, ari-avic-au=ʔai maanu=mita pati-manəŋ-au. ʔakuni=ʔai ʔa-pa-taŋi-ai," kisa-ən kan=kiai ʔucaŋ-ini.
S.PHON: pakaʂiinkani saruanai teeku sumasərəʦə taniara sauni sua iikasu ia nuu teekasuini muukusa ʔumaʔuma ia ariaviʦauʔai maanumita patimanəŋau ʔakuniʔai ʔapataŋiai kisaən kankiai ʔuʦaŋini
S.FORM: pakasiinkani saruanai, "teeku s<um>aserece taniara sauni. sua iikasu ia, nuu teekasuini muukusa 'uma'uma ia, ariavicau'ai maanumita patimanengau. 'akuni'ai 'apatangiai," kisaen kankiai 'ucangini.
S.PHON: pakaʂiinkani sa[r|ɾ]uanai teeku sumase[r|ɾ]eʦe tania[r|ɾ]a sauni sua iikasu ia nuu teekasuini muukusa ʔumaʔuma ia a[r|ɾ]iaviʦauʔai maanumita patimaneŋau ʔakuniʔai ʔapataŋiai kisaen kankiai ʔuʦaŋini
S.TRANSL: The man said, "I'm going to check the traps today, and if you're going to the fields, please take our child with you, and take good care of her. Don't let her cry," he said so to his wife.

S.PHON: əəʔə misakani ʔuʦaŋin
eeʔe misakani ʔuʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: "OK," his wife said.

S.FORM: mu-caan=cu sua saruanai mu-kusa rəmər-a, ʔacu-ai=cu ka-vaŋvaŋ ʔucaŋ-ini, ʔacu=kani ʔuma-ʔuma.
S.PHON: muʦaanʦu sua saruanai mukusa rəməra ʔaʦuaiʦu kavaŋvaŋ ʔuʦaŋini ʔaʦukani ʔumaʔuma
S.FORM: mucaancu sua saruanai mukusa remera, 'acuaicu kavangvang 'ucangini, 'acukani 'uma'uma.
S.PHON: muʦaanʦu sua sa[r|ɾ]uanai mukusa [r|ɾ]eme[r|ɾ]a ʔaʦuaiʦu kavaŋvaŋ ʔuʦaŋini ʔaʦukani ʔumaʔuma
S.TRANSL: The man went to the mountain while his wife and daughter went to the fields.

S.PHON: makaaʂikan ʔumaʔumaini matuapuɾukani ʔaraʔaravaŋ taruʔanini
makaaʂikan ʔumaʔumaini matuapu[r|ɾ]ukani ʔa[r|ɾ]aʔa[r|ɾ]avaŋ ta[r|ɾ]uʔanini
S.TRANSL: When she was in the fields, she made a fire in their hut.

S.FORM: si sua cəpəŋ-ini ia, ma-naasə ʔuuna sikulapə misai
S.PHON: ʂi sua ʦəpəŋini ia manaasə ʔuuna ʂikuɾapə misai
S.FORM: si sua cepengini ia, manaase 'uuna sikurape misai
S.PHON: ʂi sua ʦepeŋini ia manaase ʔuuna ʂiku[r|ɾ]ape misai
S.TRANSL: Because she thought there would be mosquitos.

S.PHON: matuapuɾukani ʔaraʔaravaŋ taruʔan misai
matuapu[r|ɾ]ukani ʔa[r|ɾ]aʔa[r|ɾ]avaŋ ta[r|ɾ]uʔan misai
S.TRANSL: It is said that she made a fire in the hut.

S.PHON: uɾuŋaikani ʔinia manuin
u[r|ɾ]uŋaikani ʔinia manuin
S.TRANSL: She untied (the braces holding) her girl there.

S.PHON: əməsəʔə ʔaraʔaravaŋ taruʔan matuapuɾu
emeseʔe ʔa[r|ɾ]aʔa[r|ɾ]avaŋ ta[r|ɾ]uʔan matuapu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: She put down (her girl) in the hut and started a fire.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: taavalaʔə=cu=kani ʔara-takarə sua maanu mu-caan=cu ha cina-ini.
S.PHON: taavaɾaʔəʦukani ʔaratakarə sua maanu muʦaanʦu ha tʂinaini
S.FORM: taavara'ecukani 'aratakare sua maanu mucaancu ha cinaini.
S.PHON: taava[r|ɾ]aʔeʦukani ʔa[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]e sua maanu muʦaanʦu ha tʂinaini
S.TRANSL: The girl could stand up, and her mother left (for work).

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: taavalaʔə=cu=kani ʔara-takarə sua maanu mu-caan=cu sua cina-ini.
S.PHON: taavaɾaʔəʦukani ʔaratakarə sua maanu muʦaanʦu sua tʂinaini
S.FORM: taavara'ecukani 'aratakare sua maanu mucaancu sua cinaini.
S.PHON: taava[r|ɾ]aʔeʦukani ʔa[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]e sua maanu muʦaanʦu sua tʂinaini
S.TRANSL: The girl could stand up, and her mother left (for work).

S.FORM: makai sua t<im>mana=maku ia, ni-ma-ki-tuku=kani cina-ini caən.
S.PHON: makai sua timmanamaku ia nimakitukukani tʂinaini ʦaən
S.FORM: makai sua t<im>manamaku ia, nimakitukukani cinaini caen.
S.PHON: makai sua timmanamaku ia nimakitukukani tʂinaini ʦaen
S.TRANSL: What I had heard is that, the mother was weeding (with a hoe).

S.PHON: pakitəəaikan ʔinia sua vunai
pakiteeaikan ʔinia sua vunai
S.TRANSL: A snake was right there.

S.FORM: karanaana sua vunai iisua kauru-ni ia, ta-ʔuici maamia.
S.PHON: karanaana sua vunai iisua kauruni ia taʔuitʂi maamia
S.FORM: karanaana sua vunai iisua kauruni ia, ta'uici maamia.
S.PHON: ka[r|ɾ]anaana sua vunai iisua kau[r|ɾ]uni ia taʔuitʂi maamia
S.TRANSL: The different (poisonous) type of snake she dug up was thin.

S.PHON: kauruni ia aratakəpə makai maaɾi
kau[r|ɾ]uni ia a[r|ɾ]atakepe makai maa[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: What she dug up was something round like a ball.

S.PHON: aɾaikan ʔinia umavitʂi na manuin
a[r|ɾ]aikan ʔinia umavitʂi na manuin
S.TRANSL: She took it and brought it to her child.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.PHON: teekani apatiamuamuarənkiai manuini misai
teekani apatiamuamua[r|ɾ]enkiai manuini misai
S.TRANSL: It was said that she was going to let her child play (with it like a toy).

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.PHON: teekani apatiamuamuarənkiai manuini misakani
teekani apatiamuamua[r|ɾ]enkiai manuini misakani
S.TRANSL: It was said that she was going to let her child play (with it like a toy).

S.FORM: mu-caan=cu mu-kusa na=mu-liuŋ taruʔan-ini tee=kani ʔuma-ʔuma.
S.PHON: muʦaanʦu mukusa namuɾiuŋ taruʔanini teekani ʔumaʔuma
muʦaanʦu mukusa namu[r|ɾ]iuŋ ta[r|ɾ]uʔanini teekani ʔumaʔuma
S.TRANSL: She left and went to the field near to the hut.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: ma-kaasi=kani cina-ini, "ni-m-i-kai-naanu=kusa-in manu=maku kaʔan t<um>a-taŋi?" "a-pataa-vəcəkai taniarə. na-taŋici" misa=kani cina-ini.
S.PHON: makaaʂikani tʂinaini nimikainaanukusain manumaku kaʔan tumataŋi apataavəʦəkai taniarə nataŋitʂi misakani tʂinaini
S.FORM: makaasikani cinaini, "nimikainaanukusain manumaku ka'an t<um>atangi?" "apataavecekai taniare. natangici" misakani cinaini.
S.PHON: makaaʂikani tʂinaini nimikainaanukusain manumaku kaʔan tumataŋi apataaveʦekai tania[r|ɾ]e nataŋitʂi misakani tʂinaini
S.TRANSL: The mother said to herself, "How come my child did not cry? It's already noon time. She is a crybaby."

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: ma-kaasi=kani cina-ini, "ni-m-i-kai-naanu=kusa-in manu=maku kaʔan t<um>a-taŋi?" misa=kan. "a-pataa-vəcəkai taniarə. na-taŋici" misa=kani cina-ini.
S.PHON: makaaʂikani tʂinaini nimikainaanukusain manumaku kaʔan tumataŋi misakan apataavəʦəkai taniarə nataŋitʂi misakani tʂinaini
S.FORM: makaasikani cinaini, "nimikainaanukusain manumaku ka'an t<um>atangi?" misakan. "apataavecekai taniare. natangici" misakani cinaini.
S.PHON: makaaʂikani tʂinaini nimikainaanukusain manumaku kaʔan tumataŋi misakan apataaveʦekai tania[r|ɾ]e nataŋitʂi misakani tʂinaini
S.TRANSL: The mother said to herself, "How come my child did not cry? It's already noon time. She is a crybaby."

S.FORM: mu-caan=kan cina-ini, ma-kaasi na taruʔan mi-a-ncau ʔinia.
S.PHON: muʦaankan tʂinaini makaaʂi na taruʔan mianʦau ʔinia
S.FORM: mucaankan cinaini, makaasi na taru'an miancau 'inia.
S.PHON: muʦaankan tʂinaini makaaʂi na ta[r|ɾ]uʔan mianʦau ʔinia
S.TRANSL: The mother (left the field) and went to the hut to peep at her.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: ʔaisi=kani ʔinia manu-ini t<in>ikəərə. ara-kicacə=kani cina-in, "aioo".
S.PHON: ʔaiʂikani ʔinia manuini tinikəərə arakiʦaʦəkani tʂinain aioo
ʔaiʂikani ʔinia manuini tinikee[r|ɾ]e a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦekani tʂinain aioo
S.TRANSL: (The body of) her child stiffened. She was astonished and cried, "Alas!"

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: ʔaisi=kani ʔinia manu-ini t<in>ikəərə. ara-kicacə=kani cina-in, "aioo" misa=kani.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂikani ʔinia manuini tinikəərə arakiʦaʦəkani tʂinain aioo misakani
ʔaiʂikani ʔinia manuini tinikee[r|ɾ]e a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦekani tʂinain aioo misakani
S.TRANSL: (The body of) her child stiffened. She was astonished and cried, "Alas!"

S.PHON: teetʂi manaanu ʔakiaʦu manumaku misakani
teetʂi manaanu ʔakiaʦu manumaku misakani
S.TRANSL: "What can I do? My child is gone!" she cried.

S.PHON: ʦəʔəraikan ʔinia ʔaʦuava niŋai vaəsə misakani
ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aikan ʔinia ʔaʦuava niŋai vaese misakani
S.TRANSL: She looked at her (body). "She must have been bitten by the snake," she said.

S.FORM: si iisua cina-ini ia, na-turu si ŋuai-ni k<um>auru vunai əm-əsəʔə na=manu-in.
S.PHON: ʂi iisua tʂinaini ia naturu ʂi ŋuaini kumauru vunai əməsəʔə namanuin
S.FORM: si iisua cinaini ia, naturu si nguaini k<um>auru vunai emese'e namanuin.
S.PHON: ʂi iisua tʂinaini ia natu[r|ɾ]u ʂi ŋuaini kumau[r|ɾ]u vunai emeseʔe namanuin
S.TRANSL: The stupid mother put the snake she dug up with her child.

S.FORM: tee=kani "a-pati-mua-muar-ən=kiai kanə ʔinia masi kaʔan t<um>a-taŋi," misai=kani sua cina-ini.
S.PHON: teekani apatimuamuarənkiai kanə ʔinia maʂi kaʔan tumataŋi misaikani sua tʂinaini
S.FORM: teekani "apatimuamuarenkiai kane 'inia masi ka'an t<um>atangi," misaikani sua cinaini.
S.PHON: teekani apatimuamua[r|ɾ]enkiai kane ʔinia maʂi kaʔan tumataŋi misaikani sua tʂinaini
S.TRANSL: "(I) meant to let her play with it like (a toy) so that she would not cry," the mother said.

S.FORM: ma-naasə ni-paku-tutu=kiai sua vunai, raʔis-ai=cu sua vunai manu-ini.
S.PHON: manaasə nipakututukiai sua vunai raʔisaiʦu sua vunai manuini
S.FORM: manaase nipakututukiai sua vunai, ra'isaicu sua vunai manuini.
S.PHON: manaase nipakututukiai sua vunai [r|ɾ]aʔisaiʦu sua vunai manuini
S.TRANSL: The snake was definitely provoked and bit her child.

S.PHON: makasuaʦu arivaikani tʂinaini tumaŋi
makasuaʦu a[r|ɾ]ivaikani tʂinaini tumaŋi
S.TRANSL: The mother held her in her arms and cried.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.PHON: muʦaan makaaʂi taanaasa tumataŋi
muʦaan makaaʂi taanaasa tumataŋi
S.TRANSL: She went home crying.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.PHON: muʦaankan makaaʂi taanaasa tumataŋi
muʦaankan makaaʂi taanaasa tumataŋi
S.TRANSL: She went home crying.

S.FORM: "misain=kasu t<um>a-taŋi?" kisa-ən kan caau, kaʔan=kan m-ali-vali.
S.PHON: misainkasu tumataŋi kisaən kan ʦaau kaʔankan maɾivaɾi
S.FORM: "misainkasu t<um>atangi?" kisaen kan caau, ka'ankan marivari.
S.PHON: misainkasu tumataŋi kisaen kan ʦaau kaʔankan ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: "Why are you crying?" people asked her, but she did not reply.

S.FORM: ni-ava=kan=kiai manu-in. makasua=cu ma-kaasi taanaasa, ʔaisi=kan t<um>a-taŋi.
S.PHON: niavakankiai manuin makasuaʦu makaaʂi taanaasa ʔaiʂikan tumataŋi
S.FORM: niavakankiai manuin. makasuacu makaasi taanaasa, 'aisikan t<um>atangi.
S.PHON: niavakankiai manuin makasuaʦu makaaʂi taanaasa ʔaiʂikan tumataŋi
S.TRANSL: She carried her child on her back home crying.

S.PHON: ruuvananʦu puaiʔiʦukan saruanai
[r|ɾ]uuvananʦu puaiʔiʦukan sa[r|ɾ]uanai
S.TRANSL: Her husband returned home in the evening.

S.PHON: ʂinmərəʦə ʔuunakan ʔaɾam niaʔuna paaʂiinkani saruanai
ʂinme[r|ɾ]eʦe ʔuunakan ʔa[r|ɾ]am niaʔuna paaʂiinkani sa[r|ɾ]uanai
S.TRANSL: The man talked to her, "(I have) checked the traps and brought home some meat.

S.FORM: "nain vanai=su kaʔan m-ali-vali, kaʔan pu-a-kari-kari?" kisa-ən=kiai sua ʔucaŋ-in.
S.PHON: nain vanaisu kaʔan maɾivaɾi kaʔan puakarikari kisaənkiai sua ʔuʦaŋin
S.FORM: "nain vanaisu ka'an marivari, ka'an puakarikari?" kisaenkiai sua 'ucangin.
S.PHON: nain vanaisu kaʔan ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i kaʔan puaka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i kisaenkiai sua ʔuʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: "Is there any reason why you would not reply to me or say anything?" her husband asked her.

S.PHON: kaʔankan maɾivaɾi sua ʔuʦaŋin
kaʔankan ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i sua ʔuʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: His wife did not reply to him.

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: makaasua=cu pasi-ʔənə-ʔəna-i=kan saruanai, "ni-m-i-kai-naanu=kasu kaʔan pu-a-kari-kari?" kisa-ən kan=kiai
S.PHON: makaasuaʦu paʂiʔənəʔənaikan saruanai nimikainaanukasu kaʔan puakarikari kisaən kankiai
S.FORM: makaasuacu pasi'ene'enaikan saruanai, "nimikainaanukasu ka'an puakarikari?" kisaen kankiai
S.PHON: makaasuaʦu paʂiʔeneʔenaikan sa[r|ɾ]uanai nimikainaanukasu kaʔan puaka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i kisaen kankiai
S.TRANSL: The man asked her again, "How come you would not reply to me?"

FORM.notes: Source parenthetical expanded under POL-026/POL-027; exact source and decision are in source_notation_audit.csv.

S.FORM: makaasua=cu pasi-ʔənə-ʔəna-i=kan ʔinia saruanai, "ni-m-i-kai-naanu=kasu kaʔan pu-a-kari-kari?" kisa-ən kan=kiai
S.PHON: makaasuaʦu paʂiʔənəʔənaikan ʔinia saruanai nimikainaanukasu kaʔan puakarikari kisaən kankiai
S.FORM: makaasuacu pasi'ene'enaikan 'inia saruanai, "nimikainaanukasu ka'an puakarikari?" kisaen kankiai

S.TRANSL: The man asked her again, "How come you would not reply to me?"
